card.summary: 12B open-weight quality flagship of the Flux.1 generation: excellent prompt following, typography, photorealism, and hands. Natural-language prompts; no true negatives.
card.commercial_use: no (outputs usable per license; model commercial use needs BFL license)
card.pick_when: Top open-weight quality / typography / photorealism and non-commercial is OK; user can wait.

prompt.guidance: Long descriptive sentences. Uses a distilled 'guidance' (~3.5), not real CFG.
prompt.example: A close-up portrait of an elderly fisherman with a weathered face and thick grey beard, yellow raincoat, standing on a wooden dock at golden hour, soft rim lighting, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 85mm lens
prompt.overview: Descriptive natural language plus comma-separated style/quality modifiers; guidance-distilled (set distilled guidance ~3.5), no true negative prompt.
prompt.instructions: Prompt following is heavily influenced by prompting style. Use descriptive natural language with comma-separated style/quality modifiers (e.g. `Astronaut in a jungle, cold color palette, muted colors, detailed, 8k`). Prompts can be fairly long (up to 512 tokens). It is guidance-distilled -- set a distilled guidance_scale around 3.5; there is no separate CFG negative-prompt mechanism, so describe what you want, not what you don't. For short in-image text, put it in the prompt (e.g. a sign that says 'hello world').
do: Use descriptive natural language + comma-separated modifiers
Include short text to render directly in the prompt
dont: Rely on negative prompts (unavailable for this distilled model)
Assume pure booru tag lists are optimal
examples: Astronaut in a jungle, cold color palette, muted colors, detailed, 8k
A cat holding a sign that says hello world
prompt.negative_guidance: Guidance-distilled (effective CFG ~1); true negative prompts are unavailable -- describe what you want.

negative.note: Distilled guidance (effective CFG 1); negatives don't work.

speed.measured_note: ~105s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 28 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
